question.text: <math><mn>10.30</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi></math> of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> is dissolved into a liter of sea water of density <math><mn>1.03</mn><mi mathvariant="normal"></mi><mi mathvariant="normal">g</mi><mo>/</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">L</mi></math> . The concentration of <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> in ppm is _____________.

solution.text:
Formula of ppm is-

ppm=weight of soluteweight of solution×106

ppm=10.3×10-31030×106 =10

PPM is a concentration term and its full form is "parts per million" and it also can be expressed as milligrams per liter (mg/L). This measurement is the mass of a chemical or contaminate per unit volume of water.
